questions.en: What is the chemical formula of bleaching powder?(
questions.hi: ब्लीचिंग पाउडर (विरंजक चूर्ण) का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bleaching powder is chemically calcium oxychloride (CaOCl2), manufactured by reacting dry slaked lime with chlorine gas: Ca(OH)2 + Cl2 -> CaOCl2 + H2O.
questions.tip: Plaster of Paris = CaSO4·1/2H2O; Gypsum = CaSO4·2H2O; Baking Soda = NaHCO3; Bleaching Powder = CaOCl2.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: ब्लीचिंग पाउडर (CaOCl2) is chemically calcium oxychloride (CaOCl2), manufactured by reacting dry slaked lime with chlorine gas: Ca(OH)2 + Cl2 -> CaOCl2 + H2O.
questions.tip_hi: प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस = CaSO4·1/2H2O; जिप्सम = CaSO4·2H2O; बेकिंग सोडा (NaHCO3) = NaHCO3; ब्लीचिंग पाउडर (CaOCl2) = CaOCl2.

questions.en: The chemical formula of washing soda is(
questions.hi: धावन सोडा (वाशिंग सोडा) का रासायनिक सूत्र है)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Washing soda is sodium carbonate decahydrate (Na2CO3·10H2O), containing 10 molecules of water of crystallization. Anhydrous sodium carbonate (Na2CO3) is termed soda ash.
questions.tip: Washing Soda = Na2CO3·10H2O; Baking Soda = NaHCO3; Caustic Soda = NaOH.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: धावन सोडा (Na2CO3·10H2O) is सोडियम कार्बोनेट decahydrate (Na2CO3·10H2O), containing 10 molecules of water of crystallization. Anhydrous सोडियम कार्बोनेट (Na2CO3) is termed soda ash.
questions.tip_hi: धावन सोडा (Na2CO3·10H2O) = Na2CO3·10H2O; बेकिंग सोडा (NaHCO3) = NaHCO3; Caustic Soda = NaOH.

questions.en: The image formed by the convex lens of the human eye on the retina is
questions.hi: मानव नेत्र के उत्तल लेंस द्वारा रेटिना पर बनने वाला प्रतिबिंब होता है
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The converging eye lens projects a real, inverted, and diminished image onto the photosensitive retina, which the brain's visual cortex perceives as upright.
questions.tip: The retinal optical image is always real and inverted; brain processing renders it upright.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The converging eye lens projects a real, inverted, and diminished image onto the photosensitive रेटिना, which the brain's visual cortex perceives as upright.
questions.tip_hi: The retinal optical image is always real and inverted; brain processing renders it upright.

questions.en: Brass is an alloy composed of(
questions.hi: पीतल (Brass) एक मिश्रधातु है, जो बनी होती है)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Brass is a non-ferrous alloy of Copper (approx. 70%) and Zinc (approx. 30%). Bronze is an alloy of Copper and Tin.
questions.tip: Memory trick: Brass = Cu + Zn (पीतल); Bronze = Cu + Sn (कांसा); Solder = Pb + Sn (टांका).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: पीतल (तांबा + जस्ता) is a non-ferrous alloy of Copper (approx. 70%) and Zinc (approx. 30%). कांस्य (तांबा + टिन) is an alloy of Copper and Tin.
questions.tip_hi: Memory trick: पीतल (तांबा + जस्ता) = Cu + Zn (पीतल); कांस्य (तांबा + टिन) = Cu + Sn (कांसा); सोल्डर (सीसा + टिन) = Pb + Sn (टांका).

questions.en: What is the total geographical area of the State of Bihar?
questions.hi: बिहार राज्य का कुल भौगोलिक क्षेत्रफल कितना है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The total area of Bihar is 94,163 square kilometres, which constitutes approximately 2.86% of India's total geographical area, ranking it 12th by land area in India.
questions.tip: Bihar area: 94,163 sq km; 2.86% of India; 3rd largest State by population (Census 2011).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The total area of Bihar is 94,163 square kilometres, which constitutes approximately 2.86% of India's total geographical area, ranking it 12th by land area in India.
questions.tip_hi: Bihar area: 94,163 sq किमी; 2.86% of India; 3rd largest State by population (जनगणना 2011).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Pointing to a photograph, a woman says, 'He is the only son of the wife of my husband's father.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.hi: एक तस्वीर की ओर इशारा करते हुए एक महिला कहती है, 'वह मेरे पति के पिता की पत्नी का एकमात्र पुत्र है।' वह पुरुष उस महिला से किस प्रकार संबंधित है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Woman's husband's father = Father-in-law. Father-in-law's wife = Mother-in-law. The only son of mother-in-law is the woman's husband.
questions.tip: 'Only son of my husband's mother/father' always refers directly to the husband.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Woman's husband's father = Father-in-law. Father-in-law's wife = Mother-in-law. The only सोन नदी of mother-in-law is the woman's husband.
questions.tip_hi: 'Only सोन नदी of my husband's mother/father' always refers directly to the husband.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Which acid is injected into human skin during an ant sting causing acute burning pain and irritation?
questions.hi: चींटी के डंक में कौन-सा अम्ल पाया जाता है जो जलन और दर्द उत्पन्न करता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Ant stings inject methanoic acid (common name formic acid, HCOOH). It is neutralized by applying mild basic substances such as baking soda (sodium hydrogen carbonate) or calamine lotion (zinc carbonate).
questions.tip: Formic acid = Ant sting; Vinegar = Acetic acid; Tomato = Oxalic acid; Tamarind = Tartaric acid.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Ant stings inject methanoic acid (common name फॉर्मिक अम्ल, HCOOH). It is neutralized by applying mild क्षारीय substances such as बेकिंग सोडा (NaHCO3) (sodium hydrogen carbonate) or calamine lotion (zinc carbonate).
questions.tip_hi: फॉर्मिक अम्ल = Ant sting; Vinegar = एसिटिक अम्ल; Tomato = ऑक्सालिक अम्ल; Tamarind = टार्टरिक अम्ल.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: What is the chemical formula of Plaster of Paris?
questions.hi: प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस का रासायनिक सूत्र क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Plaster of Paris is calcium sulphate hemihydrate, CaSO4 · 1/2H2O (or 2CaSO4 · H2O), formed by heating gypsum (CaSO4 · 2H2O) at 373 K (100°C).
questions.tip: Gypsum = dihydrate (2H2O); Plaster of Paris = hemihydrate (1/2 H2O).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस is calcium sulphate hemihydrate, CaSO4 · 1/2H2O (or 2CaSO4 · H2O), formed by heating जिप्सम (CaSO4 · 2H2O) at 373 K (100°C).
questions.tip_hi: जिप्सम = dihydrate (2H2O); प्लास्टर ऑफ पेरिस = hemihydrate (1/2 H2O).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Galvanization is the process of applying a protective coating of which metal onto iron or steel to prevent rusting?(
questions.hi: लोहे या इस्पात को जंग से बचाने के लिए उस पर किस धातु की परत चढ़ाने की प्रक्रिया को गैल्वनीकरण (यशदलेपन) कहते हैं?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Galvanization involves dipping iron/steel into molten zinc to form a protective barrier. Even if the zinc coating is scratched, zinc acts as a sacrificial anode because it oxidizes preferentially over iron.
questions.tip: Galvanization = Zinc (Zn) coating on Iron (Fe).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Galvanization involves dipping iron/steel into molten zinc to form a protective barrier. Even if the zinc coating is scratched, zinc acts as a sacrificial anode क्योंकि it oxidizes preferentially over iron.
questions.tip_hi: Galvanization = Zinc (Zn) coating on Iron (Fe).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Which Constitutional Amendment Act reduced the voting age for citizens of India from 21 years to 18 years?
questions.hi: किस संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम द्वारा भारतीय नागरिकों के लिए मतदान की आयु 21 वर्ष से घटाकर 18 वर्ष की गई थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The 61st Constitutional Amendment Act of 1988 amended Article 326 of the Constitution, lowering the voting age from 21 to 18 years. It came into force on 28 March 1989 under Rajiv Gandhi's government.
questions.tip: Voting age reduction (21 to 18) = 61st Amendment 1988 (Article 326).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The 61st संविधान संशोधन अधिनियम of 1988 amended अनुच्छेद 326 of the Constitution, lowering the voting age from 21 to 18 वर्ष. It came into force on 28 मार्च 1989 under Rajiv Gandhi's government.
questions.tip_hi: Voting age reduction (21 to 18) = 61st संशोधन 1988 (अनुच्छेद 326).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Which non-metal is in liquid state at standard room temperature (25°C)?(
questions.hi: मानक कमरे के तापमान (25°C) पर कौन-सा अधातु द्रव अवस्था में रहता है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Bromine (Br, atomic number 35) is the only non-metallic element that is liquid at room temperature. Mercury is a liquid metal, not a non-metal.
questions.tip: Crucial distinction: Liquid Metal = Mercury (Hg); Liquid Non-metal = Bromine (Br).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Bromine (Br, atomic number 35) is the only non-metallic element that is liquid at room temperature. Mercury is a liquid metal, not a non-metal.
questions.tip_hi: Crucial distinction: Liquid Metal = Mercury (Hg); Liquid Non-metal = Bromine (Br).

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: During the Salt Satyagraha of 1930 in Patna, which historic location was chosen by the local leaders to manufacture salt and defy colonial law?
questions.hi: 1930 के नमक सत्याग्रह के दौरान पटना में स्थानीय नेताओं द्वारा नमक बनाने और औपनिवेशिक कानून की अवज्ञा के लिए किस ऐतिहासिक स्थल को चुना गया था?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: In Patna city, under the leadership of Ambika Kant Sinha, the satyagrahis marched to Nakhas Pond (Nakhas Pind) in Mangal Talab area on 16 April 1930 to manufacture salt and inaugurate the civil disobedience movement.
questions.tip: Salt Satyagraha in Patna = Nakhas Pond (नखास पिंड), led by Ambika Kant Sinha.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: In Patna city, under the leadership of Ambika Kant Sinha, the satyagrahis marched to Nakhas Pond (Nakhas Pind) in Mangal Talab area on 16 अप्रैल 1930 to manufacture salt and inaugurate the civil disobedience movement.
questions.tip_hi: Salt Satyagraha in Patna = Nakhas Pond (नखास पिंड), led by Ambika Kant Sinha.

questions.source: BPSC TRE 3.0 - PRT & Middle School GS
questions.en: Which river in Bihar is infamously referred to as the 'Sorrow of Bihar' due to its frequent avulsion and catastrophic floodings?
questions.hi: बिहार की किस नदी को उसके मार्ग परिवर्तन और विनाशकारी बाढ़ के कारण 'बिहार का शोक' कहा जाता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: The Kosi River rises in Tibet/Nepal (Saptakoshi) and enters Bihar at Bhimnagar (Supaul). Due to massive silt load and braided channels, it has shifted westward by over 130 km over 250 years, causing repeated disasters.
questions.tip: Sorrow of Bihar = Kosi; Sorrow of Bengal = Damodar.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: The कोसी नदी River rises in Tibet/Nepal (Saptakoshi) and enters Bihar at Bhimnagar (Supaul). Due to massive silt load and braided channels, it has shifted westward by over 130 किमी over 250 वर्ष, causing repeated disasters.
questions.tip_hi: Sorrow of Bihar = कोसी नदी; Sorrow of Bengal = Damodar.

questions.en: What is the chemical name and formula of ordinary baking soda used in cooking?
questions.hi: रसोई में प्रयुक्त होने वाले साधारण बेकिंग सोडा का रासायनिक नाम और सूत्र क्या है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Baking soda is sodium bicarbonate / sodium hydrogen carbonate, NaHCO3. When heated during baking, it decomposes to release CO2 gas, which causes bread or cake batter to rise and become spongy.
questions.tip: Baking Soda = NaHCO3 (Bicarbonate); Washing Soda = Na2CO3 · 10H2O.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: बेकिंग सोडा (NaHCO3) is सोडियम बाइकार्बोनेट / sodium hydrogen carbonate, NaHCO3. When heated के दौरान baking, it decomposes to release CO2 gas, which causes bread or cake batter to rise and become spongy.
questions.tip_hi: बेकिंग सोडा (NaHCO3) = NaHCO3 (Bicarbonate); धावन सोडा (Na2CO3·10H2O) = Na2CO3 · 10H2O.

questions.en: Who among the following was martyred by hanging for assassinating Phanindra Nath Ghosh, the government approver in the Lahore Conspiracy Case?
questions.hi: लाहौर षड्यंत्र केस के सरकारी गवाह फणीन्द्र नाथ घोष की हत्या करने के कारण निम्नलिखित में से किसे फांसी की सजा दी गई थी?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Baikunth Shukla assassinated the traitor Phanindra Nath Ghosh in Bettiah in November 1932 to avenge the martyrdom of Bhagat Singh, Sukhdev, and Rajguru. He was arrested, convicted, and hanged at Gaya Central Jail on 14 May 1934.
questions.tip: Assassination of approver Phanindra Nath Ghosh = Baikunth Shukla (hanged at Gaya Jail 1934).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Baikunth Shukla assassinated the traitor Phanindra Nath Ghosh in Bettiah in नवम्बर 1932 to avenge the martyrdom of भगत सिंह, Sukhdev, and Rajguru. He was arrested, convicted, and hanged at Gaya Central Jail on 14 मई 1934.
questions.tip_hi: Assassination of approver Phanindra Nath Ghosh = Baikunth Shukla (hanged at Gaya Jail 1934).

questions.en: Which famous freshwater lake in Jammu and Kashmir is celebrated as the largest natural freshwater lake in India?
questions.hi: जम्मू और कश्मीर में स्थित कौन-सी प्रसिद्ध झील भारत की सबसे बड़ी प्राकृतिक मीठे पानी की झील मानी जाती है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Wular Lake, situated in Bandipora district of Jammu & Kashmir and fed by the Jhelum River, is a tectonic depression lake recognized as India's largest natural freshwater lake and a designated Ramsar site.
questions.tip: Largest freshwater lake in India = Wular Lake (J&K); Largest brackish/saltwater lagoon = Chilika Lake (Odisha).
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Wular Lake, situated in Bandipora district of Jammu & Kashmir and fed by the Jhelum River, is a tectonic depression lake recognized as India's largest natural freshwater lake and a designated Ramsar site.
questions.tip_hi: Largest freshwater lake in India = Wular Lake (J&K); Largest brackish/saltwater lagoon = Chilika Lake (Odisha).

questions.en: Rusting of an iron nail in moist air is an example of which type of transformation?
questions.hi: नम वायु में लोहे की कील पर जंग लगना किस प्रकार के परिवर्तन का उदाहरण है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Rusting is an irreversible chemical oxidation reaction where iron reacts with atmospheric oxygen in the presence of water to form hydrated ferric oxide: 4Fe + 3O2 + 2xH2O -> 2Fe2O3 · xH2O. It increases the mass of the iron object.
questions.tip: Rusting is a chemical change, oxidation reaction, and increases the weight of iron.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Rusting is an irreversible chemical oxidation reaction where iron reacts with atmospheric oxygen in the presence of water to form hydrated ferric oxide: 4Fe + 3O2 + 2xH2O -> 2Fe2O3 · xH2O. It increases the mass of the iron object.
questions.tip_hi: Rusting is a chemical change, oxidation reaction, and increases the weight of iron.

questions.en: Which chemical compound is commonly used in laboratory fire extinguishers and baked goods as a leavening agent?
questions.hi: अग्निशामक यंत्रों और बेकरी उत्पादों में खमीर उठाने के लिए आमतौर पर किस रासायनिक यौगिक का उपयोग किया जाता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Sodium bicarbonate (NaHCO3) reacts with acids in soda-acid fire extinguishers to release large volumes of carbon dioxide (CO2) gas that blanket and extinguish fires.
questions.tip: Sodium bicarbonate = Fire extinguishers + Baking soda.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: सोडियम बाइकार्बोनेट (NaHCO3) reacts with acids in soda-acid fire extinguishers to release large volumes of carbon dioxide (CO2) gas that blanket and extinguish fires.
questions.tip_hi: सोडियम बाइकार्बोनेट = Fire extinguishers + बेकिंग सोडा (NaHCO3).

questions.en: Which law of physics explains the working principle of hydraulic brakes and hydraulic presses?
questions.hi: भौतिकी का कौन-सा नियम हाइड्रोलिक ब्रेक और हाइड्रोलिक प्रेस के कार्य सिद्धांत की व्याख्या करता है?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Pascal's Principle states that pressure applied to an enclosed, incompressible fluid is transmitted undiminished equally in all directions throughout the fluid and to the walls of its container.
questions.tip: Hydraulic lift / brakes = Pascal's Law; Aeroplane wing lift = Bernoulli's Principle; Buoyancy = Archimedes' Principle.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Pascal's Principle states that pressure applied to an enclosed, incompressible fluid is transmitted undiminished equally in all directions throughout the fluid and to the walls of its container.
questions.tip_hi: Hydraulic lift / brakes = Pascal's Law; Aeroplane wing lift = Bernoulli's Principle; Buoyancy = Archimedes' Principle.

questions.en: In which year was the 'Bihar Caste-based Survey 2022-23' (जाति आधारित गणना) formally notified and conducted by the Government of Bihar?
questions.hi: बिहार सरकार द्वारा 'बिहार जाति आधारित गणना 2022-23' किस वर्ष अधिसूचित और संपन्न की गई?
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Conducted in two phases during 2023, the findings of the Bihar Caste-based Survey were officially released on Gandhi Jayanti (2 October 2023), recording EBCs at 36.01%, OBCs at 27.13%, SCs at 19.65%, STs at 1.68%, and General Category at 15.52%.
questions.tip: Bihar Caste Survey released on 2 October 2023: EBC (36%) + OBC (27%) = 63% total backward classes.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Conducted in two phases के दौरान 2023, the findings of the Bihar Caste-based Survey were officially released on Gandhi Jayanti (2 अक्टूबर 2023), recording EBCs at 36.01%, OBCs at 27.13%, SCs at 19.65%, STs at 1.68%, and General Category at 15.52%.
questions.tip_hi: Bihar Caste Survey released on 2 अक्टूबर 2023: EBC (36%) + OBC (27%) = 63% total backward classes.

questions.en: Which chemical element in the periodic table has the highest electronegativity value on the Pauling scale?(
questions.hi: आवर्त सारणी में पॉलिंग पैमाने पर किस रासायनिक तत्व की विद्युत ऋणात्मकता (Electronegativity) सर्वाधिक होती है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Fluorine (F, atomic number 9) has the highest electronegativity of 4.0 on the Pauling scale due to its small atomic size and high effective nuclear charge. Oxygen (3.5) and Chlorine (3.0) are second and third.
questions.tip: Highest Electronegativity = Fluorine (4.0); Highest Electron Affinity = Chlorine.
options_hi: उपर्युक्त में से एक से अधिक
questions.explanation_hi: Fluorine (F, atomic number 9) has the highest electronegativity of 4.0 on the Pauling scale due to its small atomic size and high effective nuclear charge. Oxygen (3.5) and Chlorine (3.0) are सेकंड and third.
questions.tip_hi: Highest Electronegativity = Fluorine (4.0); Highest Electron Affinity = Chlorine.

questions.en: What is the total geographical forest cover in the State of Bihar as per the India State of Forest Report (ISFR) 2021?(
questions.hi: भारत वन स्थिति रिपोर्ट (ISFR) 2021 के अनुसार, बिहार राज्य में कुल भौगोलिक वनावरण (Forest Cover) कितना है?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: According to ISFR 2021, the recorded forest cover of Bihar is 7,380.79 sq km, which constitutes 7.84% of the State's total geographical area (94,163 sq km). Kaimur district has the highest forest cover (31.56%).

questions.en: An aqueous solution turns blue litmus paper red. What is the probable nature of this solution and its pH value?

options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Acids turn blue litmus red and have a pH less than 7 at 25°C. Bases turn red litmus blue and have a pH greater than 7.
questions.tip: Memory rule: 'BAR' = Blue to Red = Acid (pH < 7); Red to Blue = Base (pH > 7).

questions.en: How many neutrons are present in the atomic nucleus of ordinary hydrogen (Protium, 1H1)?(
questions.hi: साधारण हाइड्रोजन (प्रोटियम, 1H1) के परमाणु नाभिक में कितने न्यूट्रॉन उपस्थित होते हैं?)
options: More than one of the above
questions.explanation: Protium (1H1) has mass number A = 1 and atomic number Z = 1. The number of neutrons N = A - Z = 1 - 1 = 0. It is the only stable isotope in nature without any neutrons in its nucleus.
questions.tip: Protium has 0 neutrons; Deuterium has 1 neutron; Tritium has 2 neutrons.
